title: No supply problem: a planned delisting
brief: Sales of SKU M-010 (milk frother) dropped 40% in France this month. Is there a supply problem, and what should we do?

evidence.content: France M-010 demand is down 40% because a major retailer delisted M-010 on 1 Nov. The delisting was planned and communicated to sales in September.
Stock levels are normal, with no stock-outs; M-010 is slightly overstocked (9 weeks of cover).
Supplier performance is normal; next PO (3,000 units) is due in 2 weeks.

answer_key.root_cause: There is no supply problem: demand fell because a major retailer delisted M-010 as planned on 1 Nov; the risk now is overstock.

remediation_rubric.criterion: Lower the forecast and reduce/defer the open PO
Redeploy excess stock to other markets or channels
State clearly there is no supply issue (no expediting)
Feed known delistings into the forecast in future
Commercial follow-up with the retailer / replacement listings

answer_key.notes: Negative control: nothing to escalate, little to forward.

registry.mechanism_opportunities: None by design; protocol overhead shows up as pure cost, and V3 false alarms would be visible.
